name: How do prefab detached ADUs compare with custom builds in LA?

mainEntity.name: Are prefab detached ADUs actually cheaper and faster than custom-built ADUs in Los Angeles?
mainEntity.text: Are prefab detached ADUs actually cheaper and faster than custom-built ADUs in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Prefab detached ADUs often sound like the fastest and cheapest option, but the final answer depends on the site and scope. Factory-built components may reduce some production time, yet the project still needs foundations, permitting, utility work, delivery access, crane placement if required, and on-site finishing. Those costs can narrow the price gap quickly. Prefab units can be attractive when the design is standard, the lot is easy to access, and the owner wants predictable manufacturing. Custom builds are better when the lot is constrained, the homeowner wants a luxury finish, or the design needs to match an existing architectural style. In Los Angeles neighborhoods with tight access or complex setbacks, a custom approach sometimes fits the site better than a prefab module. The real comparison should be total installed cost, schedule reliability, and design fit, not just factory pricing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prefab ADUs can be faster in fabrication and sometimes simpler to price, but they are not automatically cheaper once transport, crane work, foundation work, permits, and site preparation are included. Custom builds usually offer more design flexibility.
